mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply index) above its 5-year average signals robust production growth, compressing inflation expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO being above its 5-year average in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month upward crossing of FEDFUNDS above 4.0% triggers a monetary tightening cycle, raising long-term interest rates and pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive (contradicting expectation) when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0% in the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS below 2.0% and rise in UNRATE above 6.0% signals a dual tightening in monetary policy and labor market tightness, amplifying growth expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative (contradicting expectation) when FEDFUNDS <2.0% and UNRATE >6.0% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In contraction phases, a sustained upward crossing of UNRATE above 7.0% indicates labor market stress, raising long-term interest rates and reducing corporate profitability expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are positive (contradicting expectation) when UNRATE crosses above 7.0% in a contraction phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 (quarterly demand) above its 3-year moving average signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) over the next 5 days despite GDPC1 being above its 3-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month upward crossing of GDPC1 above 13,000 (in billions) signals strong quarterly demand growth, leading to elevated corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 13,000 in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 13,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous upward crossing of PAYEMS above 132,000 (labor force) and UNRATE rising by over 0.2 percentage points signals labor market expansion and reduced wage pressures, fostering investor optimism and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 132.0 AND UNRATE rises >0.2pp in the next month
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS crosses above 132.0 and UNRATE rises >0.2pp in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion phases, a sustained downward crossing of FEDFUNDS below 1.5% signals easing monetary policy, lowering long-term rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60 days are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS crosses below 1.5% in a late-cycle expansion.
